vessels.title: Vase
vessels.license: CC0 as stated by PurePNG; source page says free for commercial use, no attribution required.
vessels.changes: Mechanically separated two vessels and cropped transparent margins. Original colors and RGBA preserved.
vessels.inspection: Photoreal glazed pottery; tall brown narrow-neck bottle and rounded bronze vase with blue glaze. RGBA alpha range 0–255. Bottle starts at top edge of supplied original. Both are usable cutouts.

alternateReference.title: NordWood Themes 2017-01-25 (Unsplash)
alternateReference.author: NordWood Themes
alternateReference.inspection: Clean bright still-life of a loose informal fern and orange marigold arrangement in a clear glass on weathered stool, white plaster wall. Do not call it a formal ikebana-school example.
